sources: RFC 791 / RFC 792: IPv4 fragmentation, TTL, DF and ICMP

RFC 9293: TCP byte stream, ports and retransmission
RFC 5905 / RFC 5424: time synchronisation and log timestamps
RFC 3704 / RFC 8704: reverse-path filtering and asymmetric routing
IEEE 802.3 / IEEE 802.1Q / IEEE 802.1Qbb: Ethernet, STP/VLAN, priority pause
Wi-Fi Alliance WPA3 / IEEE 802.11: SAE, RSNA key hierarchy, PMF, OFDMA, regulatory channel use
Cisco UDLD / RSTP platform guides; Linux iproute2, NetworkManager and systemd-networkd configuration semantics
